verdict.rationale: e-FRRO is a public web service, and any web service could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows either one. The probes found that the root serves a script-only application shell that reduces to 12 characters of text for a keyless agent. They also found that the long-published entry path returns 404. Both point to a surface that is unfriendly to agents rather than one with agent-oriented docs.
